BiblicalUsage: Reu was the son of Peleg and the father of Serug, living two hundred and thirty-nine years in the line that runs from Shem to Abraham. He stands in the genealogy between the tower and the call.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the quiet links in the chain matter, for without Reu there is no Abraham, and without Abraham there is no promise.
